name: CBI Cables
old_description: CBI Cables has been providing top quality cabling products to the entertainment industry for over 40 years.  All assemblies are completed in our Upstate New York facility by our very talented and dedicated technicians.  Our sales team is just a phone call away – real people, real help, right when you need it!
about:
CBI Cables has operated from Oriskany, New York, for more than four decades. The company was established to serve the entertainment industry with cabling products, and all assemblies are completed at its Upstate New York facility by a dedicated technical staff. No founding year or founder names are publicly disclosed.

The company produces a range of cable assemblies including audio, video, data, lighting, power, and bulk cables. Assembly work is performed in-house by technicians at the Oriskany facility. The firm does not publish facility square footage, employee count, or annual volume figures.

CBI Cables serves the entertainment industry, supplying cables for applications such as live events, theater, broadcast, and related professional audio-visual installations. The company sells directly to end users and integrators through a sales team that is reachable by phone.

The company emphasizes that its assemblies are built domestically and that customers have direct phone access to sales representatives for support. This combination of in-house production and responsive service is presented as its core distinction.
